name: Checkbox
summary: Independent boolean. Square 16 px (md). Unchecked = hairline ring on input bg; checked = lime fill + dark check glyph. Built on Radix Checkbox; uses .lumen-checkbox shell.

rules: Always paired with a visible label or aria-label.
Group multiple related checkboxes inside a fieldset with a visible legend.
Touch target ≥ 44 × 44 px — extend the clickable area to the label, not just the box.

do: Use Checkbox for independent booleans (one or many can be checked).
Use a label that reads as a complete sentence with the box checked ("Email me about new features" not "Email").
Indeterminate state via Radix's `data-state="indeterminate"` for partial selections in a list.
dont: Don't use Checkbox for mutually exclusive options — use RadioGroup.
Don't use Checkbox for an immediate action (toggle a setting that takes effect now) — use Switch.
Don't ship `rounded-[4px]` Tailwind arbitrary values — use --radius-xs.

changelog.note: Initial release. Adopts .lumen-checkbox shell. Bug fix: replaced `rounded-[4px]` Tailwind arbitrary value with --radius-xs token.
